summary: A cast-iron 'sparkplug' lighthouse on Great Beds Shoal in Raritan Bay, lit in 1880 and automated in 1945; now privately owned and reachable only by boat.

access.note: Offshore; reachable only by boat. Privately owned since 2011 auction (LighthouseFriends); tower closed.

notes_for_editor: NRHP prints 'David J. Johnson' for the 1890s keeper; roster and LighthouseFriends say David C. Johnson. NRHP tower+lantern 47 ft vs LighthouseFriends 42 ft (both stated in story). LighthouseFriends dates Johnson's disappearance to 18 Aug 1883; NRHP log entries 25-26 Aug. Newspaper reports (NYT 1883) are second-hand via LighthouseFriends. Current owner unknown; privately owned per LighthouseFriends after the 2011 GSA auction. Page numbers for bulletins are PDF pages from corpus grep, not printed pages. NRHP gives the Fresnel removal as 1942 (history section) and as 1945 (description section); story states both. FOG bell: NRHP says double strike per 1898 report, single strike by 1901; LighthouseFriends (Notice to Mariners) says single blow. Bulletin 1925 page: printed p. 89, PDF page 31. No OCR table position matches used.
